errors.title: Bad Request
errors.meaning: The server cannot process the request due to malformed syntax or missing required fields.
errors.typical_cause: Invalid payload, missing mandatory fields in JSON, or corrupt multipart upload.
errors.explanation: The request was missing required information or had an invalid format.
errors.recovery_action: Check your form inputs or upload parameters and try again.

errors.title: Unauthorized
errors.meaning: Authentication is required and has failed or has not been provided.
errors.typical_cause: Missing or expired Bearer / Token authorization header, or session timeout.
errors.explanation: You need to be logged in to perform this operation.
errors.recovery_action: Log in with your email and password or refresh your session.

errors.title: Forbidden
errors.meaning: The client does not have permission to access the requested resource.
errors.typical_cause: Attempting to view or edit another user’s resume, match analysis, or modifying protected sample jobs.
errors.explanation: You do not have permission to access or edit this resource.
errors.recovery_action: Ensure you are signed in to the account that owns this resource.

errors.title: Not Found
errors.meaning: The server cannot find the requested resource or endpoint route.
errors.typical_cause: Incorrect URL path, deleted resume or job ID, or non-existent record.
errors.explanation: The requested page or resource could not be found.
errors.recovery_action: Check the URL or return to the Dashboard.

errors.title: Too Many Requests
errors.meaning: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.
errors.typical_cause: Exceeded rate limit for resume parsing, AI chat, or matching operations.
errors.explanation: You have exceeded the request rate limit for this action.
errors.recovery_action: Please wait a moment before sending another request.

errors.title: Internal Server Error
errors.meaning: The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.
errors.typical_cause: Unhandled exception, database query error, or parsing crash.
errors.explanation: An unexpected server error occurred. Our engineering team has been notified.
errors.recovery_action: Try again in a few seconds or submit a support ticket if the issue persists.

errors.title: Service Unavailable
errors.meaning: The server is currently unable to handle the request due to maintenance or upstream dependency failure.
errors.typical_cause: Background database maintenance, ML service offline, or network partition.
errors.explanation: The service is temporarily unavailable. Upstream services may be restarting.
errors.recovery_action: Wait 30 seconds and retry your operation.

errors.title: Resume Processing Failed
errors.meaning: The document could not be converted or text could not be extracted by the parsing engine.
errors.typical_cause: Scanned/image-only PDF without OCR text, password-protected PDF, corrupted DOCX file, or unsupported binary encoding.
errors.explanation: We were unable to extract readable text from your uploaded resume.
errors.recovery_action: Ensure the file is a text-selectable PDF or DOCX file under 10MB and does not require a password.
